item.text: {"decisions":[{"decision_id":"1af5d37b0a0e054913db-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"詳細說明 Wireshark 顯示過濾器，可篩選已擷取封包。","evidence":"Wireshark provides a display filter language that enables you to precisely control which packets are displayed."},{"decision_id":"31700d17ad0873cc263c-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"提供依指定 IP 位址顯示來源或目的封包的具體語法。","evidence":"to only display packets to or from the IP address 192.168.0.1, use ip.addr==192.168.0.1"},{"decision_id":"b25fe61d73e14cd72a06-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"說明記錄 TLS 金鑰並在 Wireshark 設定金鑰檔以解密封包的流程。","evidence":"You can specify the key file path in Wireshark via Edit -> Preferences -> Protocols -> TLS -> (Pre)-Master-Secret log filename ."},{"decision_id":"b599d60507a0c1373800-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"內容為 TLS 工作階段金鑰記錄與解密，未說明代理 CA 安裝或用戶端信任設定。","evidence":"The SSL/TLS master keys can be logged by mitmproxy so that external programs can decrypt SSL/TLS connections both from and to the proxy."}]}
